threat_model.threat_source: Mesa-optimizers — 'internal optimization processes' that neural networks may develop, 'with distinct objectives known as mesa-objectives' — also described as 'subsidiary learning algorithms' that LLMs develop during training.
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Harmful outcome (stated as a potential): 'These subsidiary algorithms could lead the system to pursue different goals than those specified by its creators—a phenomenon researchers call mesa optimization.' The mesa-optimizers are stated to have 'distinct objectives known as mesa-objectives,' but the content of those objectives is not specified.
threat_model.capability: The subsidiary learning algorithms 'adjust behavior as they process new information–without any parameter changes that would have prompted that behavior.'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: 'When neural networks become sufficiently complex,' they may develop mesa-optimizers; the subsidiary learning algorithms develop 'during training.'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: 'The system' and its pursuit of the goals 'specified by its creators' — i.e., the system being led 'to pursue different goals than those specified by its creators.'

evidence.threat_source: 'when neural networks become sufficiently complex, they may develop internal optimization processes called mesa-optimizers with distinct objectives known as mesa-objectives'; 'researchers discovered that LLMs develop subsidiary learning algorithms during training'
evidence.objective_or_harmful_outcome: 'These subsidiary algorithms could lead the system to pursue different goals than those specified by its creators—a phenomenon researchers call mesa optimization.'; 'distinct objectives known as mesa-objectives'
evidence.capability: 'LLMs develop subsidiary learning algorithms during training that adjust behavior as they process new information–without any parameter changes that would have prompted that behavior.'
evidence.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: 'when neural networks become sufficiently complex, they may develop internal optimization processes called mesa-optimizers'; 'LLMs develop subsidiary learning algorithms during training'
evidence.target_or_asset_at_risk: 'These subsidiary algorithms could lead the system to pursue different goals than those specified by its creators'
